explanation: Pakistan began in two parts, about 1,600 km (1,000 miles) apart. The eastern wing broke away in 1971 to become Bangladesh.

claims.text: In 1947 British India was partitioned into India and Pakistan.
Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Myanmar were not created by the 1947 partition of British India.
Pakistan was created in two parts, East and West, about 1,600 km (1,000 miles) apart.
East Pakistan became independent as Bangladesh in 1971.
